From developer 24 Entertainment comes a brand new single player adventure set during China's Dunhuang Uprising. Built on Unreal Engine 5, the story sees our rebellious hero battle his way through a town in an early slice of gameplay - where animations, physics and UE5 features like Lumen all combine to ground the experience. Tom runs through the demo, with insights from the studio itself.
